# Type Led

**Carry › Type-Led** · v1.0.0 · 54 frames at 30 fps (30–100)

A word lands on the old scene and stays put while the scene changes behind it, then flies away.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/type-led@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Title cards
- Chapter names
- Keyword-driven edits

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import typeLed from './transitions/08-carry/type-led/type-led';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(typeLed, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 54 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.
